capec_cwe_refs.known_false_positive_note: CAPEC-60 (Reusing Session IDs) is retained as an analogy for UDS SecurityAccess replay attacks per R155:6.1. CWE linkage is imprecise for bare-metal ECU contexts. Filter web-specific CWEs (CWE-294, CWE-488, CWE-539) from this entry in ISO 21434 output rendering. Prefer CAPEC-112 or CAPEC-21 for CAN/UDS credential reuse scenarios.
